name: Oregon 4-H Youth Development
org: OSU Extension Service, Oregon State University
what_you_do: Join a local 4-H club and pick projects like animals, robots, sewing, food saving or nature science. Clubs meet through your county Extension office.
who_can_apply: Oregon youth. Check with your local 4-H program coordinator to find a club and project that fit your area.
pay_detail: Not stated on the page. Ask your county 4-H office about enrollment fees.
deadline_text: The 4-H year begins October 1. Online enrollment opens the last week of September. The page was written for the 2025-26 year, so check the 2026-27 dates with your county.
how_to_apply: Contact your local 4-H program coordinator. They will help you find a club. Then sign up online in 4-HOnline. Or return the paper forms to your county 4-H office.
notes: The page was written for the 2025-2026 4-H year. Not every project is offered in every county, since it depends on volunteers. To join in another county, you need an Out of County Participation Form.
